.. _example_usage:

Comprehensive Example Usage (Colab Notebook)
=============================================

This section provides a comprehensive, runnable example demonstrating the use of various modules within `neusen_reveal` in a typical workflow. This example is presented as a Google Colab-compatible notebook, which you can adapt for your own data and analyses.


.. literalinclude:: ../../example_usage_notebook.ipynb
   :language: ipython
   :linenos:

.. note::
   The file paths in this example (`/content/drive/MyDrive/...`) are specific to Google Colab when Google Drive is mounted. Adjust these paths to match your local data storage if running outside of Colab.
